profile.title: Profile
profile.canAct: Can approve: accept quotes, agree contracts, accept acts
profile.name: Name

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.linkedText: Notifications about quotes, invoices, acts and manager replies arrive in Telegram right away. The account opens right in the bot, no email needed.
notifications.notLinkedText: Connect Telegram to get notifications instantly and open the account right in the bot. Until then, notifications arrive by email.
notifications.scanQr: Scan the QR code with your phone camera or press the button — the bot will open. Press “Start” in the bot.
notifications.pressStart: Press the button — the bot will open. Press “Start” in the bot.
notifications.qrLabel: QR code of the bot link
notifications.validUntil: The link is valid until {{time}} and works once.
notifications.unavailable: You can connect Telegram once your manager adds you to the system — please write to them.
notifications.consequence: Notifications will stop arriving in Telegram — email and the account remain. Signing in to the account from Telegram will be closed. You can connect again right here.

requests.title: Requests
requests.emptyText: Your requests and their status will appear here: new, in progress, quoted, closed.

requestNew.title: New request
requestNew.summaryHint: Describe the task in your own words: what, how much and by when. Up to 5000 characters.
requestNew.summaryRequired: Describe what you need — at least one sentence.
requestNew.linesHint: List items or work in free text — exact part numbers are not required. Empty lines are not sent.
requestNew.quantityInvalid: Quantity must be a positive number, e.g. 12 or 2.5.
requestNew.attachmentsLater: For now send specifications and drawings to your manager — file upload to the cabinet is coming later.
requestNew.attachmentsHint: PDF, DOCX, XLSX or images up to 10 MB
requestNew.viewOnlyTitle: Requests can be created by a contact with approval rights
requestNew.viewOnlyText: Ask a colleague with this right or your manager to send the request.
requestNew.consequence: Your request gets a number and goes to a RailTech manager. They will prepare a quote — it will appear under “Quotes”, and we will notify you in Telegram or by email.

next.new: Request received — a manager will pick it up.
next.quoted: The quote is ready — open it below.

quotes.title: Quotes
quotes.emptyText: As soon as the manager sends a quote it will appear here — accept or reject it right from the cabinet.

quoteDetail.title: Quote {{number}}
quoteDetail.acceptText: Total {{total}}. Enter the confirmation code from the message. The contract is created automatically after acceptance.
quoteDetail.codeHint: Enter the code from the message. If it did not arrive, send it again.
quoteDetail.codeTooShort: The code is at least {{min}} characters long.
quoteDetail.acceptedPending: The contract is being drawn up — it will appear under “Contracts”, where you can agree it.
quoteDetail.acceptedReadyToSign: Contract {{number}} is ready — agree it under “Contracts”.
quoteDetail.rejectText: Tell us what did not fit — the manager will take it into account in the next version.
quoteDetail.rejectPlaceholder: For example: the delivery time does not work for us
quoteDetail.expiredText: It can no longer be accepted. Ask your manager to update the offer.
quoteDetail.requestCodeText: Total {{total}}. Press “Get code” — we will send a confirmation code to your Telegram or e-mail. The contract is created automatically after acceptance.

codeSent.telegram: The code was sent to Telegram. Valid for {{minutes}} min.
codeSent.telegramTo: The code was sent to Telegram ({{to}}). Valid for {{minutes}} min.
codeSent.email: The code was sent to {{to}}. Valid for {{minutes}} min.

quoteDetail.commentPlaceholder: A question or a remark on the quote
quoteDetail.commentConsequence: Your manager receives the comment. The quote does not change — you can still accept or decline it afterwards.

contracts.title: Contracts
contracts.emptyText: A contract is created automatically once a quote is accepted; you can agree it here.
contracts.signText: You confirm, on behalf of your company, that you agree with the contract wording. Signing is a separate step: the e-document operator issues the contract and we will tell you when it is signed.
contracts.signedBoth: Contract {{number}} is signed by both parties.

invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.emptyText: Issued invoices, payments and due dates will appear here.

proofDialog.title: I have paid: invoice {{number}}
proofDialog.text: Attach the payment order from your bank — PDF or photo, up to 10 MB. Amount due: {{remaining}}.
proofDialog.fileHint: PDF or image, up to 10 MB
proofDialog.commentPlaceholder: For example: paying in instalments, the second part by the end of the month
proofDialog.consequence: Your manager will check the incoming payment and confirm it — then the invoice status changes.
proofDialog.sent: Payment order for invoice {{number}} sent to your manager

problem.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB.
problem.badType: A PDF or an image is required.
problem.amount: The amount must be a number above zero with at most two decimals.
problem.future: The payment date cannot be later than today.
problem.dateInvalid: Enter the date as DD.MM.YYYY, for example 14.10.2026.

acts.title: Acts
acts.emptyText: Acts for completed deliveries and services: accept or return with a reason.
acts.acceptText: You confirm that the delivery or work under this act is complete and you have no claims.
acts.returnText: The act goes back to the provider for correction. Describe what is wrong.
acts.returnPlaceholder: For example: the serial number is missing
acts.scanHint: PDF or image up to 10 MB. You can also accept the act without a scan.

scanProblem.tooLarge: The file is larger than 10 MB — choose a smaller one.
scanProblem.badType: A PDF or an image is required.

deliveries.title: Deliveries
deliveries.emptyText: Status per line, expected date and tracking number.
deliveries.disputeText: Describe the issue (defect, missing parts, damage). The manager will contact you.
deliveries.disputePlaceholder: For example: labeling defect or transport damage

documents.emptyText: Quotes, contracts, invoices, acts and waybills — download them from here.
documents.emptyKindText: Choose another kind or show all documents.

catalog.emptyText: Published goods and services with price and availability.

attention.title: Prices need attention
attention.text: Outdated: {{stale}}. Expired: {{expired}}. Expiring soon: {{expiring}}. Confirm that your prices are current — it takes one click.
attention.expiredHint: Expired prices cannot be confirmed — upload a new price list.

empty.title: Upload a price list from the template — your cards will appear here
empty.text: Three simple steps. Cards start as drafts; after review we publish them in the catalog.
empty.stepsLabel: How to upload a price list
empty.step1Text: An Excel file with ready columns and hints for allowed values.
empty.step2Text: Add products and prices: one row per product. Only the name and the price are required.
empty.step3Text: We check the file and show errors by row before anything is saved.

submitDialog.title: Submit for review?
submitDialog.consequence: The cards become “In review” and go to a catalog employee. While under review, price lists do not change them: differences go to “changes under review”.
submitDialog.nothing: No cards can be submitted: only drafts and returned cards can.

submitted.sla: Review usually takes 1 business day. The result appears in this tab: “Published” or “Returned” with a reason.

confirmed.expired: Not confirmed because the price expired: {{count}}. Upload a new price list.

code.NOT_FOUND: you have no price for this card

confirmed.none: There are no prices to confirm.

sheet.description: A product card from your list
sheet.historyEmpty: This card has not been submitted for review yet.
sheet.foreignNote: Your price is matched to a catalog card. The card data is not shown to you: below is what you sent in your price list.

wizard.title: Upload a price list
wizard.description: Download the template, fill it in and upload the file. We check everything first — nothing is saved until you press “Upload”.
wizard.templateText: The same columns our employees use: name, brand, part number, price, currency, lead time…
wizard.validityText: Optional. Without a date, the “Valid from / to” columns are used, or the price has no end date.
wizard.rangeInvalid: The “until” date cannot be earlier than the “from” date.
wizard.tooLarge: The file is larger than 20 MB.
wizard.checkingText: Nothing is saved. It takes a few seconds.
wizard.previewWithErrors_one: {{count}} row has an error. We will skip it and upload the rest.
wizard.previewWithErrors_other: {{count}} rows have errors. We will skip them and upload the rest.
wizard.nothingToLoad: Nothing to upload: no row passed the check. Fix the file and check again.
wizard.loadWithSkipped: Upload without the rows with errors
wizard.doneText: The cards are now in “Drafts”. Check them and submit for review.
wizard.failedText: The file could not be processed.

failedCode.NAME_COLUMN_NOT_FOUND: The file has no “Name” column. Download the template and copy your data into it.
failedCode.IMPORT_FAILED: The file could not be processed. Make sure it is the Excel template and try again.

wizard.proposalsText: These products are already in the catalog. Your prices are saved, and field changes went to review without changing the cards.
wizard.truncated: The file is over the limit — rows not read: {{count}}.
wizard.unpublishable_one: {{count}} card cannot be published without additions.
wizard.unpublishable_other: {{count}} cards cannot be published without additions.
wizard.unpublishableHint: Missing: {{list}}. Fill in these columns in the file and upload it again.

issues.PRICE_NOT_A_NUMBER: The price must be a number, for example 150.50.

issues.UNKNOWN_DOMAIN: The type “{{value}}” is not in the list. Pick one from the second sheet of the template.
issues.UNKNOWN_CURRENCY: The currency “{{value}}” is not in the list. Use a code such as USD or UZS.
issues.UNKNOWN_STOCK_STATUS: The availability “{{value}}” is not in the list. Pick a code from the second sheet of the template.

issues.HS_CODE_RETIRED: The HS code “{{value}}” is no longer valid. The row was uploaded — confirm the code.
issues.ROW_FAILED: The row could not be processed. Check its values.
issues.NAME: The name is missing.
